items.title: Correct or delete an invoice from Invoice Detail
items.detail: The artist must be able to fix an invoice's details or remove one created by mistake; the PRD asks for both "from the Invoice Detail screen", but the plan's Invoice Detail screen does not include these actions.

items.title: Edit or delete a bill from the Bills list
items.detail: The artist must be able to edit a bill's details or remove one added by mistake; the PRD asks for removal "from the Bills list", and the plan's Bills screen has no edit or delete actions.

items.title: Small salon owner with 1 to 3 assistants as a user
items.detail: The PRD lists small salon owners with 1 to 3 assistants as target users, but the plan has only the solo freelance persona.
